about.title: About The Village
about.subtitle: Building stronger communities through mutual aid and genuine connection — in your neighborhood and your school
about.missionText1: The Village is a hyperlocal platform designed to strengthen communities through mutual aid and genuine connection. Whether it's your neighborhood or your child's school, we help neighbors and families organize, coordinate, and support each other — because it takes a village.
about.missionText2: Built on the principles of mutual aid, our platform creates spaces where community members help each other as equals — sharing rides, lending tools, coordinating childcare, organizing block parties, and building the deep bonds that make neighborhoods and schools feel like home.
about.whyMutualAidText1: Mutual aid is voluntary, reciprocal exchange of resources and services for mutual benefit. In neighborhoods and schools, this means families and neighbors supporting each other as equals — because we're all in this together.
about.whyMutualAidText2: Instead of waiting for someone else to step up, mutual aid creates networks where everyone contributes what they can and receives what they need. The neighbor who helps with yard work today might need a meal train tomorrow. The parent organizing carpools this month might join a childcare swap next month.
about.reciprocalDesc: Everyone gives and receives. Helper today, recipient tomorrow.
about.equalDesc: We're all community members helping each other.
about.empoweringDesc: Building resilient communities that support each other.
about.sustainableDesc: Long-term relationships that grow stronger over time.
about.communityCenteredDesc: Organized around your neighborhood or school, so you connect with the people you actually see every day — at the bus stop, the park, or drop-off.
about.hyperlocalDesc: Built for your immediate community. Strong support networks start with the people closest to you — your neighbors and your school families.
about.privacyFirstDesc: Your data is yours. We don't sell your information, track you across the web, or share details with third parties.
about.communityLedDesc: Built by community members, for community members. Your feedback shapes how this platform grows to serve your neighborhood and school.
about.alwaysFreeDesc: No premium tiers, no hidden fees. Community support should be accessible to every family and every neighbor.
about.leadCompassionDesc: Everyone is doing their best. We assume the best intentions and offer grace to our neighbors and fellow families.
about.celebrateDiversityDesc: All families, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and beliefs are welcome. Our communities are stronger when everyone belongs.
about.communicateClearlyDesc: Be honest, direct, and follow through on your commitments. Reliable communication keeps communities running smoothly.
about.keepSafeDesc: Respect boundaries, protect privacy, and prioritize safety for all community members, especially children. Safety is non-negotiable.
about.shareGenerouslyDesc: Contribute what you can, when you can. No contribution is too small, and everyone has something to offer their community.
